title: Software Engineer Intern 2027
description:
As a Software Engineering Intern at Neighbor you will be building technology to power our nation-wide online marketplace. Join us as a full eng team member to build and release real features to the Neighbor marketplace.
 
We are looking for smart people who work hard. You will work closely with a dedicated mentor who will help you learn Neighbor’s systems and will be dedicated to your success. You will also have significant influence on our strategy by helping to define product features, design innovative user experiences, prioritize projects, drive the system architecture, and take ownership over key initiatives to create a quality product for our users.
 
Each year, our interns are surprised with exactly how much trust and opportunities to grow they are given. Interns are full team members that participate in the major initiatives of their team, not relegated to some meaningless effort that never gets deployed to production. Our mission is to revolutionize the $500B self-storage industry with technology. Come join the most exciting startup in Utah!

title: Marketing Operations Intern (Part time)
description:
At Neighbor, we’re building the largest hyperlocal storage and parking marketplace in the world. We’ve raised over $75 million from top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace operates in all 50 states, and we’re just getting started!
About the Role
As our Marketing Operations Intern, you’ll help scale one of Neighbor’s most important growth channels: Google Maps. This role is highly execution-focused and will involve setting up, managing, and optimizing Google Maps pins at scale in partnership with Neighbor hosts.
This is a part-time internship of approximately 20 hours per week.
